messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick thread 10 final checklist for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Short ask: confirm AMI/Image IDs, publisher tenant, and revenue-share language by EOD.

devin-ops: AMI published to staging: `ami-0f9e8d7c6b5a43210` (x86_64) and multi-arch container pushed to gcr.io/redwood/marketplace:2026-03-24. Smoke tests passed.

nina-aws: Received AMI. Need license text and `Marketplace` tag value. Also confirm if SI connectors will be bundled or separate SKUs.
tom-azure: Azure needs publisher tenant GUID and offer display name to complete the offer setup. Also check allowed regions for trials.
elaine-legal: On revenue-share: partner asked for 20%, legal prefers sticking to 15% unless finance signs off. Also adding a short SI carveout clause to the marketplace addendum. Will post redlines.
jen-marketing: Placeholder hero + 1-line blurb ready: "Secure, low-latency LLM inference for production apps." Will swap when legal finalizes wording. Need final copy 48h before publish.
anna-partnerships: Publisher tenant GUID: `a3b2c1d4-55ee-4f77-9a2b-123456789abc`. Offer display: "Redwood Inference - Marketplace". For SI: we'll ship connectors as separate SKU.

devin-ops: Noted 10 will add `si_metadata.json` to artifacts and tag AMI with `Marketplace=redwood` and `Arch=x86_64`.

eleine-legal: (typo corrected) Elaine-legal: :thumbsup: I'll upload addendum and revenue-share note in 2 hours.

anna-partnerships: Great. React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done so I can run the upload tomorrow at 09:00 PT.
